title: Where Americans Resettle
tagline: An interactive map of internal US migration — every line a state- or county-pair where people changed their tax-filing address. The premise: we're immigrants in our own country.
card_question: We are immigrants in our own country. Where does everybody go?
source: IRS Statistics of Income · county-to-county migration · 2011–12 to 2021–22
discussion_prompt: What did this make you notice about the place you left, or the place you landed?
